description: Most people, regardless of political affiliation, agree on at least one thing: government should be transparent.It is one of those rare ideas that brings nearly everyone together. Ask ten people what they want from government, and you will get ten different answers. Ask those same ten people if they want transparency, and suddenly you have a unanimous vote. If only everything were that easy.And yet, despite broad agreement on the principle, trust in government continues to decline.That raises an
title: Trust in Government Starts with Transparency
